parties: Patanjali Govind Keswani; Lemon Tree Hotels Limited
headline: Patanjali Govind Keswani Files Substantial Acquisition Disclosure Under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Patanjali Govind Keswani has filed a mandatory disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, signalling either a substantial acquisition of shares in Lemon Tree Hotels or a triggering event requiring immediate disclosure to the exchange.
implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the 2011 Takeover Code is a post-event filing required within 2 working days of crossing a threshold or reaching a triggering condition; this marks a change-in-control or material shareholding event that will likely require follow-on disclosures under Regulations 29–30 and may trigger an open offer obligation depending on the acquirer's final stake and category.
detail: Patanjali Govind Keswani has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, the primary exchange for Lemon Tree Hotels (LEMONTREE), indicating a substantial acquisition event or a threshold-crossing in shareholding. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure within 2 working days of a triggering event (share purchase, options exercise, or pledge of shares). This filing precedes any formal open offer announcement under Regulations 26–27 and is the gating disclosure for Takeover Code compliance. The precise shareholding, acquisition date, and consideration remain to be disclosed in the full regulation 29/30 forms filed concurrently or within the statutory timeline.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of share acquisition or threshold event within 2 working days; precondition for all further takeover-code disclosures.
Detailed disclosure forms (Form C / Form D) filed by acquirer and company; contain shareholding, consideration, and acquirer details.
Threshold and open-offer mechanics; apply if acquirer holds >25% or breaches 25%/35%/55%/75% slabs; determine open-offer obligation.
May apply if acquirer is a promoter or related party; affects open-offer exemption eligibility.

Board composition, director appointment/removal, and related-party transaction approval under corporate law; applicable post-acquisition.
